✅ Yeni scripts/make-shorts.mjs (tam dosya)

js
// scripts/make-shorts.mjs
// End-to-end: Topic+script (OpenAI → fallback) → TTS (ElevenLabs → OpenAI → Windows SAPI) → SRT → FFmpeg render → YouTube upload
// Updates:
// - Deterministic daily topic fallback based on QC_TODAY + QC_SLOT (no random repeats)
// - Subtitles can be disabled via DISABLE_SUBTITLES=1 (default recommended)
// - Robust OAuth token bootstrap (installed/web) + interactive code paste
// - Windows-safe ffmpeg subtitles path: C:/ -> C\:/ (critical)

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
import { spawn } from "child_process";
import { fileURLToPath } from "url";
import { google } from "googleapis";
import OpenAI from "openai";
import dotenv from "dotenv";
import readline from "readline";

dotenv.config({ path: path.resolve(process.cwd(), ".env") });

// ---------- Paths & bootstrap ----------
const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");
const TMP  = path.join(ROOT, "tmp");
fs.mkdirSync(TMP, { recursive: true });

function log(...a){ console.log("[make-shorts]", ...a); }
function warn(...a){ console.warn("[make-shorts][WARN]", ...a); }

// ---------- ENV & defaults ----------
const ENV = process.env;
const OPENAI_MODEL = ENV.OPENAI_MODEL || "gpt-4o-mini";
const OPENAI_API_KEY = ENV.OPENAI_API_KEY || "";
const ELEVEN_API_KEY = ENV.ELEVEN_API_KEY || "";
const ELEVEN_VOICE_ID = ENV.ELEVEN_VOICE_ID || "21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM";

const SECRET_PATH = ENV.YOUTUBE_CLIENT_SECRET_PATH || path.join(ROOT, "secrets", "client_secret.json");
const TOKEN_PATH  = ENV.YOUTUBE_TOKEN_PATH || path.join(ROOT, "secrets", "youtube_token.json");
const PRIVACY = (process.argv.includes("--privacy") ? process.argv[process.argv.indexOf("--privacy")+1] : ENV.YOUTUBE_PRIVACY) || "unlisted";

// Render settings
const CANVAS_SIZE = ENV.SHORTS_SIZE || "1080x1920";
const BG_COLOR_HEX = ENV.SHORTS_BG || "0x111827";
const WAVE_HEIGHT = Number(ENV.SHORTS_WAVE_HEIGHT || 300);
const WAVE_MARGIN_BOTTOM = Number(ENV.SHORTS_WAVE_MARGIN || 120);
const LOGO_PATH = path.join(ROOT, "assets", "logo.png");

// Behavior flags
const DISABLE_SUBTITLES = ((ENV.DISABLE_SUBTITLES || "1").trim() === "1"); // default: ON (no burned captions)
const OFFLINE_SHORTS = ((ENV.OFFLINE_SHORTS || "").trim() === "1");

// Deterministic context (used for topic rotation)
const QC_TODAY = (ENV.QC_TODAY || "").trim(); // yyyy-mm-dd (prefer from scheduler)
const QC_SLOT  = (ENV.QC_SLOT  || "").trim(); // "1" or "2"

// ---------- small utils ----------
function safeForFFmpegSubPath(p){
  // ffmpeg subtitles filter on Windows needs:
  // - backslash -> slash
  // - escape single quotes
  // - escape drive letter colon (C:\ -> C\:/) because ":" is option separator in filtergraph
  let s = p.replace(/\\/g, "/").replace(/'/g, "\\'");
  s = s.replace(/^([A-Za-z]):\//, "$1\\:/"); // C:/ -> C\:/ (critical fix)
  return s;
}

async function checkCmd(cmd, args = ["-version"]){
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const p = spawn(cmd, args, { stdio: ["ignore", "ignore", "ignore"] });
    p.on("error", () => resolve(false));
    p.on("close", (code) => resolve(code === 0));
  });
}

function assertFile(p, hint){
  if (!fs.existsSync(p)) {
    throw new Error(`${hint} bulunamadı: ${p}`);
  }
}

function ensureDirForFile(filePath){
  const dir = path.dirname(filePath);
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
}

function ask(question){
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const rl = readline.createInterface({ input: process.stdin, output: process.stdout });
    rl.question(question, (answer) => {
      rl.close();
      resolve((answer || "").trim());
    });
  });
}

function readYouTubeClientSecret(secretPath){
  const raw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(secretPath, "utf8"));
  // Google may produce either {installed:{...}} or {web:{...}}
  const sec = raw.installed || raw.web;
  if (!sec?.client_id || !sec?.client_secret) {
    throw new Error("client_secret.json formatı beklenmedik (installed/web yok).");
  }
  return sec;
}

function hash32(str){
  // simple deterministic hash (FNV-1a-ish)
  let h = 2166136261;
  for (let i=0;i<str.length;i++){
    h ^= str.charCodeAt(i);
    h = Math.imul(h, 16777619);
  }
  return h >>> 0;
}

function localDateKey(){
  // yyyy-mm-dd local time
  const d = new Date();
  const pad = (n)=> String(n).padStart(2,"0");
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth()+1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}`;
}

async function runFFmpeg(args){
  return new Promise((resolve, reject)=>{
    log("ffmpeg", args.join(" "));
    const p = spawn("ffmpeg", args, {stdio:["ignore","inherit","inherit"]});
    p.on("error", (err) => reject(err));
    p.on("close",(code)=> code===0 ? resolve() : reject(new Error("ffmpeg exit "+code)));
  });
}

async function runFFprobeDuration(audioPath){
  return new Promise((resolve, reject)=>{
    const p = spawn(
      "ffprobe",
      ["-v","error","-show_entries","format=duration","-of","default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1", audioPath],
      {stdio:["ignore","pipe","pipe"]}
    );
    let out=""; p.stdout.on("data",d=>out+=d.toString());
    let err=""; p.stderr.on("data",d=>err+=d.toString());
    p.on("error", (e) => reject(e));
    p.on("close",(code)=> code===0 ? resolve(Math.max(0, parseFloat(out.trim()||"0"))) : reject(new Error(err||"ffprobe failed")));
  });
}

function toSrt(cues){
  let idx=1, out="";
  const pad=(n)=> String(Math.floor(n)).padStart(2,"0");
  const ms=(t)=>{
    const h = Math.floor(t/3600);
    const m = Math.floor((t%3600)/60);
    const s = Math.floor(t%60);
    const millis = Math.round((t - Math.floor(t))*1000);
    return `${pad(h)}:${pad(m)}:${pad(s)},${String(millis).padStart(3,"0")}`;
  };
  for(const c of cues){
    out += `${idx++}\r\n${ms(c.start)} --> ${ms(c.end)}\r\n${c.text}\r\n\r\n`;
  }
  return out;
}

function splitCaptions(scriptText, totalSec){
  const raw = scriptText
    .replace(/\s+/g," ")
    .trim()
    .split(/(?<=[\.\!\?])\s+|(?<=,)\s+|(?<=;)\s+/g)
    .filter(s=>s && s.length>2);

  const lines = raw.length>0 ? raw : [scriptText];
  const minDur = 1.2, maxDur = 3.0;
  const avg = Math.min(maxDur, Math.max(minDur, totalSec / lines.length));
  const cues=[];
  let t=0;

  for(const l of lines){
    const dur = Math.min(maxDur, Math.max(minDur, avg));
    cues.push({ start:t, end:Math.min(totalSec, t+dur), text:l });
    t += dur;
    if (t >= totalSec) break;
  }
  if(cues.length && cues[cues.length-1].end < totalSec) cues[cues.length-1].end = totalSec;
  return cues;
}

// ---------- 1) OpenAI: topic + script (with fallback) ----------
async function makeScript(){
  const bank = [
    {
      title: "What drives crypto in the next 30 days?",
      bullets: [
        "Watch macro: rates, liquidity and risk appetite.",
        "Track network activity (users/fees) not just price.",
        "Mind catalysts: upgrades, ETF flows, unlocks.",
        "Stick to risk controls; volatility cuts both ways.",
        "Follow QuantumCoin for daily insights."
      ]
    },
    {
      title: "Understanding Bitcoin funding and liquidity",
      bullets: [
        "Funding rates hint at long/short bias—extremes fade.",
        "Stablecoin growth can indicate sidelined demand.",
        "On-chain fees show real demand for blockspace.",
        "Zoom out to weekly trends, not 1-min noise.",
        "Follow QuantumCoin for daily insights."
      ]
    },
    {
      title: "3 rules for surviving crypto volatility",
      bullets: [
        "Position small; scale with confirmation.",
        "Define invalidation before you enter.",
        "Avoid leverage into major events.",
        "Context beats headlines every time.",
        "Follow QuantumCoin for daily insights."
      ]
    }
  ];

  const fallbackDeterministic = () => {
    const dateKey = QC_TODAY || localDateKey();
    const slotKey = QC_SLOT || "1";
    const seed = `${dateKey}:${slotKey}`;
    const idx = hash32(seed) % bank.length;
    const pick = bank[idx];
    const script = pick.bullets.join(" ");
    return {
      title: pick.title.slice(0,80),
      description: "60s crypto explainer — no hype, just signals.",
      hashtags: ["#shorts","#crypto","#QuantumCoin"],
      script
    };
  };

  // Hard offline switch
  if (OFFLINE_SHORTS) return fallbackDeterministic();

  try{
    if(!OPENAI_API_KEY) throw new Error("OPENAI_API_KEY missing");
    const client = new OpenAI({ apiKey: OPENAI_API_KEY });

    const sys = `You are a concise YouTube Shorts writer for a crypto news channel named QuantumCoin.
- Output short, punchy English narration (90–120 words).
- Avoid hype or financial advice. No price targets. Be factual and clear.
- End with a single-sentence CTA like: "Follow QuantumCoin for daily insights."`;

    // Add a stable “rotation hint” so even OpenAI outputs vary deterministically per day/slot
    const dateKey = QC_TODAY || localDateKey();
    const slotKey = QC_SLOT || "1";

    const user = `Write a new English Shorts voiceover about a timely cryptocurrency topic (choose one concrete theme yourself).
Rotation key: ${dateKey} slot ${slotKey}. Make it different from yesterday.

Return ONLY this JSON object:

{
  "title": "<max 80 chars>",
  "description": "<max 150 chars>",
  "hashtags": ["#shorts","#crypto","#QuantumCoin"],
  "script": "<90-120 words of voiceover>"
}`;

    const r = await client.chat.completions.create({
      model: OPENAI_MODEL,
      temperature: 0.7,
      messages: [{role:"system",content:sys},{role:"user",content:user}]
    });

    const txt = r.choices?.[0]?.message?.content?.trim() || "";
    let json;
    try { json = JSON.parse(txt.replace(/^```json|```$/g,"")); }
    catch { throw new Error("Parse fail"); }
    if(!json?.script) throw new Error("No script");

    json.title = (json.title||"QuantumCoin Shorts").slice(0,80);
    json.description = (json.description||"Crypto insight in 60s").slice(0,150);
    if(!Array.isArray(json.hashtags)) json.hashtags = ["#shorts","#crypto","#QuantumCoin"];

    return json;
  }catch(_){
    // 429 / parse / no key -> deterministic fallback (no repeats within same day slots)
    return fallbackDeterministic();
  }
}

// ---------- 2) TTS with multi-fallback ----------
async function makeTTS(text, outMp3Path){
  // 2.1 ElevenLabs
  if (ELEVEN_API_KEY) {
    try{
      const voice = ELEVEN_VOICE_ID || "21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM";
      const url = `https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/${voice}/stream`;
      const resp = await fetch(url, {
        method:"POST",
        headers:{ "xi-api-key": ELEVEN_API_KEY, "Content-Type":"application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          text,
          voice_settings:{ stability:0.35, similarity_boost:0.75 },
          model_id:"eleven_multilingual_v2",
          output_format:"mp3_44100_128"
        })
      });
      if(!resp.ok) throw new Error("ElevenLabs TTS failed: " + resp.status);
      const buf = Buffer.from(await resp.arrayBuffer());
      fs.writeFileSync(outMp3Path, buf);
      return outMp3Path;
    }catch(e){
      warn("ElevenLabs TTS error:", e?.message || e);
    }
  }

  // 2.2 OpenAI TTS
  if (OPENAI_API_KEY) {
    try{
      const client = new OpenAI({ apiKey: OPENAI_API_KEY });
      const res = await client.audio.speech.create({
        model: "gpt-4o-mini-tts",
        voice: "alloy",
        input: text,
        format: "mp3"
      });
      const buf = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
      fs.writeFileSync(outMp3Path, buf);
      return outMp3Path;
    }catch(e){
      warn("OpenAI TTS error:", e?.message || e);
    }
  }

  // 2.3 Windows SAPI → WAV, then MP3
  const txtPath = path.join(TMP, "tts.txt");
  const wavPath = path.join(TMP, "tts.wav");
  fs.writeFileSync(txtPath, text, "utf8");

  await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
    const ps = spawn("pwsh", ["-NoProfile","-Command", `
      Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Speech;
      $s=New-Object System.Speech.Synthesis.SpeechSynthesizer;
      $s.Rate=0; $s.Volume=100;
      try { $s.SelectVoice('Microsoft David Desktop'); } catch {}
      $s.SetOutputToWaveFile('${wavPath.replace(/\\/g,"/")}');
      $t=[IO.File]::ReadAllText('${txtPath.replace(/\\/g,"/")}');
      $s.Speak($t); $s.Dispose();
    `], {stdio:["ignore","inherit","inherit"]});
    ps.on("close",(c)=> c===0 ? resolve() : reject(new Error("SAPI TTS failed")));
  });

  await runFFmpeg(["-y","-i", wavPath, "-codec:a","libmp3lame","-b:a","128k", outMp3Path]);
  return outMp3Path;
}

// ---------- 3) Render (waveform + optional BG video/image + optional logo + optional subtitles) ----------
async function renderVideo(audioPath, srtPath, outPath, durationSec){
  const dur = Math.max(10, Math.ceil(durationSec));
  const [W,H] = CANVAS_SIZE.split("x").map(n=>parseInt(n,10));
  const bgMp4 = path.join(ROOT, "assets", "bg.mp4");
  const bgImg = path.join(ROOT, "assets", "bg.jpg");
  const hasLogo = fs.existsSync(LOGO_PATH);

  const wave = `[0:a]showwaves=s=${W}x${WAVE_HEIGHT}:mode=cline:rate=25:colors=FFFFFF@0.9,format=rgba[wave];`;
  const overlayY = Math.max(0, H - WAVE_HEIGHT - WAVE_MARGIN_BOTTOM);

  // subtitles
  const style = "FontName=Arial,Fontsize=54,PrimaryColour=&H00FFFFFF&,OutlineColour=&H000000&,BorderStyle=1,Outline=2,Shadow=0,Alignment=2,MarginV=80";
  const subFilter = `subtitles='${safeForFFmpegSubPath(srtPath)}':force_style='${style}'`;

  const logoPrep = hasLogo ? `[2:v]scale=720:-1:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,format=rgba[logo];` : "";

  let args = ["-y", "-i", audioPath];
  let filter = wave;

  // helper: build filter chain (withSubtitles bool)
  const buildChain = (withSubs) => {
    const subPart = withSubs ? subFilter : "format=rgba"; // no subs => just keep format
    const lastLabel = hasLogo ? "v2" : "v1";

    return (
      `[1:v]scale=${W}:${H}:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=${W}:${H},setsar=1[vbg];` +
      `[vbg][wave]overlay=(W-w)/2:${overlayY}[v1];` +
      (hasLogo ? logoPrep + `[v1][logo]overlay=(W-w)/2:(H-h)/2[v2];` : "") +
      `[${lastLabel}]${subPart}[vout]`
    );
  };

  const commonOutArgs = (out) => ([
    "-map", "[vout]", "-map", "0:a",
    "-c:v","libx264","-pix_fmt","yuv420p","-r","30",
    "-c:a","aac","-b:a","128k",
    "-shortest",
    out
  ]);

  if (fs.existsSync(bgMp4)) {
    args.push("-stream_loop","-1","-t", String(dur), "-i", bgMp4);
    if (hasLogo) args.push("-i", LOGO_PATH);

    filter += buildChain(!DISABLE_SUBTITLES);

    args.push("-filter_complex", filter, ...commonOutArgs(outPath));

  } else if (fs.existsSync(bgImg)) {
    args.push("-loop","1","-t", String(dur), "-i", bgImg);
    if (hasLogo) args.push("-i", LOGO_PATH);

    filter += buildChain(!DISABLE_SUBTITLES);

    args.push("-filter_complex", filter, ...commonOutArgs(outPath));

  } else {
    args.push("-f","lavfi","-t", String(dur), "-i", `color=c=${BG_COLOR_HEX}:s=${CANVAS_SIZE}`);
    if (hasLogo) args.push("-i", LOGO_PATH);

    filter +=
      `[1:v]format=rgba[vbg];` +
      `[vbg][wave]overlay=(W-w)/2:${overlayY}[v1];` +
      (hasLogo ? logoPrep + `[v1][logo]overlay=(W-w)/2:(H-h)/2[v2];` : "") +
      `[${hasLogo ? "v2" : "v1"}]${(!DISABLE_SUBTITLES ? subFilter : "format=rgba")}[vout]`;

    args.push("-filter_complex", filter, ...commonOutArgs(outPath));
  }

  // If subtitles disabled, do a single run (no need retry)
  if (DISABLE_SUBTITLES) {
    await runFFmpeg(args);
    return;
  }

  // If subtitles enabled, try with subs, fallback without subs
  try {
    await runFFmpeg(args);
  } catch(e) {
    warn("Subtitle render failed, retrying without subtitles. Reason:", e?.message || e);

    // rebuild filter_complex without subs
    const i = args.indexOf("-filter_complex");
    if (i > -1) {
      // Rebuild filter fresh and replace
      let rebuilt = wave;

      if (fs.existsSync(bgMp4) || fs.existsSync(bgImg)) {
        rebuilt += buildChain(false);
      } else {
        // lavfi color case already built inline above; easiest: remove subtitles roughly
        // but we can rebuild it too:
        rebuilt +=
          `[1:v]format=rgba[vbg];` +
          `[vbg][wave]overlay=(W-w)/2:${overlayY}[v1];` +
          (hasLogo ? logoPrep + `[v1][logo]overlay=(W-w)/2:(H-h)/2[v2];` : "") +
          `[${hasLogo ? "v2" : "v1"}]format=rgba[vout]`;
      }

      args[i+1] = rebuilt;
    }

    await runFFmpeg(args);
  }
}

// ---------- YouTube token bootstrap ----------
async function ensureYouTubeToken(oauth2){
  if (fs.existsSync(TOKEN_PATH)) {
    const tok = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(TOKEN_PATH, "utf8"));
    oauth2.setCredentials(tok);
    return;
  }

  log("YouTube OAuth token not found. Starting one-time authorization flow...");
  const scopes = ["https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.upload"];

  const authUrl = oauth2.generateAuthUrl({
    access_type: "offline",
    scope: scopes,
    prompt: "consent",
    response_type: "code",
  });

  console.log("\n=== YOUTUBE AUTH REQUIRED ===");
  console.log("1) Open this URL in your browser:\n");
  console.log(authUrl);
  console.log("\n2) Approve, then copy the 'code' parameter from the redirected URL.\n");

  const code = await ask("Paste code here: ");
  if (!code) throw new Error("OAuth code boş geldi.");

  const { tokens } = await oauth2.getToken(code);
  oauth2.setCredentials(tokens);

  ensureDirForFile(TOKEN_PATH);
  fs.writeFileSync(TOKEN_PATH, JSON.stringify(tokens, null, 2), "utf8");
  log("Saved new token to:", TOKEN_PATH);
}

// ---------- 4) Upload (googleapis) ----------
async function uploadToYouTube(filePath, title, desc, privacy){
  assertFile(SECRET_PATH, "YOUTUBE_CLIENT_SECRET_PATH");

  const sec = readYouTubeClientSecret(SECRET_PATH);

  // IMPORTANT: redirect URI must match OAuth client settings
  const redirectUri = (process.env.GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI || "http://localhost").trim();
  const oauth2 = new google.auth.OAuth2(sec.client_id, sec.client_secret, redirectUri);

  await ensureYouTubeToken(oauth2);

  const youtube = google.youtube({ version:"v3", auth: oauth2 });

  const res = await youtube.videos.insert({
    part: ["snippet","status"],
    requestBody: {
      snippet: { title, description: desc },
      status: { privacyStatus: privacy }
    },
    media: { body: fs.createReadStream(filePath) }
  });

  return `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=${res.data.id}`;
}

// ---------- MAIN ----------
(async () => {
  try {
    if (!await checkCmd("ffmpeg")) warn("ffmpeg bulunamadı; PATH'e ekli olduğundan emin ol.");
    if (!await checkCmd("ffprobe")) warn("ffprobe bulunamadı; PATH'e ekli olduğundan emin ol.");

    log("Generating topic & script...");
    const gen = await makeScript();
    log("Title:", gen.title);

    const voicePath = path.join(TMP, "short-voice.mp3");
    log("TTS...");
    await makeTTS(gen.script, voicePath);

    log("ffprobe duration...");
    const dur = await runFFprobeDuration(voicePath);
    log("Audio duration:", dur.toFixed(2), "s");

    const outPath = path.join(TMP, "shorts-out.mp4");

    // If subtitles disabled, skip SRT creation entirely
    let srtPath = path.join(TMP, "shorts.srt");
    if (!DISABLE_SUBTITLES) {
      log("Build SRT...");
      const cues = splitCaptions(gen.script, dur);
      const srt = toSrt(cues);
      fs.writeFileSync(srtPath, srt, "utf8");
    } else {
      // keep placeholder path (render won't use it)
      try { fs.writeFileSync(srtPath, "", "utf8"); } catch {}
      log("Subtitles disabled (DISABLE_SUBTITLES=1). Rendering without burned captions.");
    }

    log("Rendering video...");
    await renderVideo(voicePath, srtPath, outPath, dur);

    const hashtags = Array.isArray(gen.hashtags) ? gen.hashtags.join(" ") : "#shorts #crypto #QuantumCoin";
    const desc = `${gen.description}\n\n${hashtags}`;

    log("Uploading to YouTube...", PRIVACY);
    const url = await uploadToYouTube(outPath, gen.title, desc, PRIVACY);

    console.log("\n=== DONE ===");
    console.log("Video:", outPath);
    console.log("YouTube:", url);

    // Optional announce (Telegram + X) through existing publish-all.ps1
    if ((process.env.ENABLE_ANNOUNCE || "").toString().trim() === "1") {
      const announce = `New Shorts: ${gen.title} ${url} #shorts #crypto`;
      try {
        await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          const ps = spawn(
            "pwsh",
            [
              "-ExecutionPolicy","Bypass",
              "-File", path.join(ROOT, "publish-all.ps1"),
              "-Text", announce,
              "-Platforms", "telegram,x",
            ],
            { stdio: "inherit" }
          );
          ps.on("close", (code) => code === 0 ? resolve() : reject(new Error("publish-all.ps1 exit " + code)));
        });
      } catch (annErr) {
        console.error("Announce failed:", annErr?.message || annErr);
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("FATAL:", e?.response?.data || e?.message || e);
    process.exit(1);
  }
})();

js
// scripts/make-shorts.mjs
// End-to-end: Topic+script (OpenAI → fallback) → TTS (ElevenLabs → OpenAI → Windows SAPI) → (optional) SRT → FFmpeg render → YouTube upload
// + NEW: YouTube schedule (18:00 / 21:00 TR) via QC_SLOT + --schedule / YOUTUBE_SCHEDULE=1

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
import { spawn } from "child_process";
import { fileURLToPath } from "url";
import { google } from "googleapis";
import OpenAI from "openai";
import dotenv from "dotenv";
import readline from "readline";
import crypto from "crypto";

dotenv.config({ path: path.resolve(process.cwd(), ".env") });

// ---------- Paths & bootstrap ----------
const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");
const TMP  = path.join(ROOT, "tmp");
fs.mkdirSync(TMP, { recursive: true });

function log(...a){ console.log("[make-shorts]", ...a); }
function warn(...a){ console.warn("[make-shorts][WARN]", ...a); }

// ---------- CLI args ----------
const ARGV = process.argv.slice(2);
const hasFlag = (f) => ARGV.includes(f);
const getArgValue = (key) => {
  const i = ARGV.indexOf(key);
  if (i === -1) return null;
  return ARGV[i+1] ?? null;
};

// ---------- ENV & defaults ----------
const ENV = process.env;

const OPENAI_MODEL = ENV.OPENAI_MODEL || "gpt-4o-mini";
const OPENAI_API_KEY = ENV.OPENAI_API_KEY || "";

const ELEVEN_API_KEY = ENV.ELEVEN_API_KEY || "";
const ELEVEN_VOICE_ID = ENV.ELEVEN_VOICE_ID || "21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM"; // example voice

const SECRET_PATH = ENV.YOUTUBE_CLIENT_SECRET_PATH || path.join(ROOT, "secrets", "client_secret.json");
const TOKEN_PATH  = ENV.YOUTUBE_TOKEN_PATH || path.join(ROOT, "secrets", "youtube_token.json");

// PRIVACY only used when NOT scheduled
const PRIVACY = (getArgValue("--privacy") || ENV.YOUTUBE_PRIVACY || "unlisted").toLowerCase();

// Render settings
const CANVAS_SIZE = ENV.SHORTS_SIZE || "1080x1920";
const BG_COLOR_HEX = ENV.SHORTS_BG || "0x111827";
const WAVE_HEIGHT = Number(ENV.SHORTS_WAVE_HEIGHT || 300);
const WAVE_MARGIN_BOTTOM = Number(ENV.SHORTS_WAVE_MARGIN || 120);
const LOGO_PATH = path.join(ROOT, "assets", "logo.png");

// Subtitles control
const DISABLE_SUBTITLES = (ENV.DISABLE_SUBTITLES || "").trim() === "1";

// Schedule controls
const SCHEDULE_ENABLED =
  hasFlag("--schedule") ||
  (ENV.YOUTUBE_SCHEDULE || "").toString().trim() === "1";

const QC_TODAY = (ENV.QC_TODAY || "").trim();            // yyyy-MM-dd (optional)
const QC_SLOT  = (ENV.QC_SLOT || "").toString().trim();  // 1 or 2 (optional)
const QC_TZ_OFFSET = (ENV.QC_TZ_OFFSET || "+03:00").trim(); // TR default

// ---------- small utils ----------
function safeForFFmpegSubPath(p){
  // ffmpeg subtitles filter on Windows needs:
  // - backslash -> slash
  // - escape single quotes
  // - escape drive letter colon (C:\ -> C\:/) because ":" is option separator in filtergraph
  let s = p.replace(/\\/g, "/").replace(/'/g, "\\'");
  s = s.replace(/^([A-Za-z]):\//, "$1\\:/"); // C:/ -> C\:/ (critical fix)
  return s;
}

async function checkCmd(cmd, args = ["-version"]){
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const p = spawn(cmd, args, { stdio: ["ignore", "ignore", "ignore"] });
    p.on("error", () => resolve(false));
    p.on("close", (code) => resolve(code === 0));
  });
}

function assertFile(p, hint){
  if (!fs.existsSync(p)) {
    throw new Error(`${hint} bulunamadı: ${p}`);
  }
}

function ensureDirForFile(filePath){
  const dir = path.dirname(filePath);
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
}

function ask(question){
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const rl = readline.createInterface({ input: process.stdin, output: process.stdout });
    rl.question(question, (answer) => {
      rl.close();
      resolve((answer || "").trim());
    });
  });
}

function readYouTubeClientSecret(secretPath){
  const raw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(secretPath, "utf8"));
  const sec = raw.installed || raw.web;
  if (!sec?.client_id || !sec?.client_secret) {
    throw new Error("client_secret.json formatı beklenmedik (installed/web yok).");
  }
  return sec;
}

function sha256Hex(s){
  return crypto.createHash("sha256").update(String(s)).digest("hex");
}

function seededPick(arr, seed){
  if (!arr.length) return null;
  const h = sha256Hex(seed);
  // take 8 hex -> int
  const n = parseInt(h.slice(0, 8), 16);
  return arr[n % arr.length];
}

function getTodayYYYYMMDD(){
  // local date (no external libs)
  const d = new Date();
  const yyyy = d.getFullYear();
  const mm = String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0");
  const dd = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,"0");
  return `${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}`;
}

function buildPublishAtISO(){
  // Returns ISO 8601 like 2026-02-02T18:00:00+03:00
  const day = QC_TODAY || getTodayYYYYMMDD();

  // slot->hour mapping (requested)
  const slot = (QC_SLOT || "1").trim();
  const hour = slot === "2" ? "21" : "18"; // default slot1 = 18
  const minute = "00";
  const second = "00";

  // Basic validation
  if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(day)) {
    throw new Error(`QC_TODAY formatı hatalı. Beklenen yyyy-MM-dd. Gelen: ${day}`);
  }
  if (!/^[\+\-]\d{2}:\d{2}$/.test(QC_TZ_OFFSET)) {
    throw new Error(`QC_TZ_OFFSET formatı hatalı. Beklenen +03:00 gibi. Gelen: ${QC_TZ_OFFSET}`);
  }

  return `${day}T${hour}:${minute}:${second}${QC_TZ_OFFSET}`;
}

async function runFFmpeg(args){
  return new Promise((resolve, reject)=>{
    log("ffmpeg", args.join(" "));
    const p = spawn("ffmpeg", args, {stdio:["ignore","inherit","inherit"]});
    p.on("error", (err) => reject(err));
    p.on("close",(code)=> code===0 ? resolve() : reject(new Error("ffmpeg exit "+code)));
  });
}

async function runFFprobeDuration(audioPath){
  return new Promise((resolve, reject)=>{
    const p = spawn("ffprobe", ["-v","error","-show_entries","format=duration","-of","default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1", audioPath], {stdio:["ignore","pipe","pipe"]});
    let out=""; p.stdout.on("data",d=>out+=d.toString());
    let err=""; p.stderr.on("data",d=>err+=d.toString());
    p.on("error", (e) => reject(e));
    p.on("close",(code)=> code===0 ? resolve(Math.max(0, parseFloat(out.trim()||"0"))) : reject(new Error(err||"ffprobe failed")));
  });
}

function toSrt(cues){
  let idx=1, out="";
  const pad=(n)=> String(Math.floor(n)).padStart(2,"0");
  const ms=(t)=>{
    const h = Math.floor(t/3600);
    const m = Math.floor((t%3600)/60);
    const s = Math.floor(t%60);
    const millis = Math.round((t - Math.floor(t))*1000);
    return `${pad(h)}:${pad(m)}:${pad(s)},${String(millis).padStart(3,"0")}`;
  };
  for(const c of cues){
    out += `${idx++}\r\n${ms(c.start)} --> ${ms(c.end)}\r\n${c.text}\r\n\r\n`;
  }
  return out;
}

function splitCaptions(scriptText, totalSec){
  const raw = scriptText
    .replace(/\s+/g," ")
    .trim()
    .split(/(?<=[\.\!\?])\s+|(?<=,)\s+|(?<=;)\s+/g)
    .filter(s=>s && s.length>2);

  const lines = raw.length>0 ? raw : [scriptText];
  const minDur = 1.2, maxDur = 3.0;
  const avg = Math.min(maxDur, Math.max(minDur, totalSec / lines.length));
  const cues=[];
  let t=0;
  for(const l of lines){
    const dur = Math.min(maxDur, Math.max(minDur, avg));
    cues.push({ start:t, end:Math.min(totalSec, t+dur), text:l });
    t += dur;
    if (t >= totalSec) break;
  }
  if(cues.length && cues[cues.length-1].end < totalSec) cues[cues.length-1].end = totalSec;
  return cues;
}

// ---------- 1) OpenAI: topic + script (with fallback) ----------
async function makeScript(){
  const bank = [
    {
      title: "What drives crypto in the next 30 days?",
      bullets: [
        "Watch macro: rates, liquidity and risk appetite.",
        "Track network activity (users/fees) not just price.",
        "Mind catalysts: upgrades, ETF flows, unlocks.",
        "Stick to risk controls; volatility cuts both ways.",
        "Follow QuantumCoin for daily insights."
      ]
    },
    {
      title: "Understanding Bitcoin funding and liquidity",
      bullets: [
        "Funding rates hint at long/short bias—extremes fade.",
        "Stablecoin growth can indicate sidelined demand.",
        "On-chain fees show real demand for blockspace.",
        "Zoom out to weekly trends, not 1-min noise.",
        "Follow QuantumCoin for daily insights."
      ]
    },
    {
      title: "3 rules for surviving crypto volatility",
      bullets: [
        "Position small; scale with confirmation.",
        "Define invalidation before you enter.",
        "Avoid leverage into major events.",
        "Context beats headlines every time.",
        "Follow QuantumCoin for daily insights."
      ]
    },
    {
      title: "Crypto security checklist in 60 seconds",
      bullets: [
        "Use a hardware wallet for long-term holdings.",
        "Never reuse passwords—use a password manager.",
        "Beware fake airdrops and wallet-drainers.",
        "Verify URLs and contract addresses twice.",
        "Follow QuantumCoin for daily insights."
      ]
    },
    {
      title: "How to read on-chain activity without hype",
      bullets: [
        "Fees and active addresses show real usage signals.",
        "Watch stablecoin supply for demand shifts.",
        "Track exchange inflows/outflows for pressure.",
        "Compare weekly trends, not single spikes.",
        "Follow QuantumCoin for daily insights."
      ]
    }
  ];

  const fallback = () => {
    // Deterministic pick by day+slot so it doesn't repeat every run on the same day/slot
    const seed = `fallback:${QC_TODAY || getTodayYYYYMMDD()}:${QC_SLOT || "1"}`;
    const pick = seededPick(bank, seed) || bank[0];
    const script = pick.bullets.join(" ");
    return {
      title: pick.title.slice(0,80),
      description: "60s crypto explainer — no hype, just signals.",
      hashtags: ["#shorts","#crypto","#QuantumCoin"],
      script
    };
  };

  if ((process.env.OFFLINE_SHORTS || "") === "1") return fallback();

  try{
    if(!OPENAI_API_KEY) throw new Error("OPENAI_API_KEY missing");

    const client = new OpenAI({ apiKey: OPENAI_API_KEY });

    // Add a tiny deterministic hint to reduce repeats even when OpenAI works
    const hint = `Today=${QC_TODAY || getTodayYYYYMMDD()} Slot=${QC_SLOT || "1"}`;

    const sys = `You are a concise YouTube Shorts writer for a crypto news channel named QuantumCoin.
- Output short, punchy English narration (90–120 words).
- Avoid hype or financial advice. No price targets. Be factual and clear.
- Use ONE concrete theme and keep it actionable.
- End with a single-sentence CTA: "Follow QuantumCoin for daily insights."`;

    const user = `Write a new English Shorts voiceover about a timely cryptocurrency topic (choose one concrete theme yourself).
Avoid repeating yesterday's idea. Context: ${hint}

Return **only** this JSON object:

{
  "title": "<max 80 chars>",
  "description": "<max 150 chars>",
  "hashtags": ["#shorts","#crypto","#QuantumCoin"],
  "script": "<90-120 words of voiceover>"
}`;

    const r = await client.chat.completions.create({
      model: OPENAI_MODEL,
      temperature: 0.8,
      messages: [{role:"system",content:sys},{role:"user",content:user}]
    });

    const txt = r.choices?.[0]?.message?.content?.trim() || "";
    let json;
    try { json = JSON.parse(txt.replace(/^```json|```$/g,"")); }
    catch { throw new Error("Parse fail"); }

    if(!json?.script) throw new Error("No script");
    json.title = (json.title||"QuantumCoin Shorts").slice(0,80);
    json.description = (json.description||"Crypto insight in 60s").slice(0,150);
    if(!Array.isArray(json.hashtags)) json.hashtags = ["#shorts","#crypto","#QuantumCoin"];
    return json;

  }catch(_){
    // 429 / key yok / parse hatası → fallback
    return fallback();
  }
}

// ---------- 2) TTS with multi-fallback ----------
async function makeTTS(text, outMp3Path){
  // 2.1 ElevenLabs
  if (ELEVEN_API_KEY) {
    try{
      const voice = ELEVEN_VOICE_ID || "21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM";
      const url = `https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/${voice}/stream`;
      const resp = await fetch(url, {
        method:"POST",
        headers:{ "xi-api-key": ELEVEN_API_KEY, "Content-Type":"application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          text,
          voice_settings:{ stability:0.35, similarity_boost:0.75 },
          model_id:"eleven_multilingual_v2",
          output_format:"mp3_44100_128"
        })
      });
      if(!resp.ok) throw new Error("ElevenLabs TTS failed: " + resp.status);
      const buf = Buffer.from(await resp.arrayBuffer());
      fs.writeFileSync(outMp3Path, buf);
      return outMp3Path;
    }catch(e){
      warn("ElevenLabs TTS error:", e?.message || e);
    }
  }

  // 2.2 OpenAI TTS
  if (OPENAI_API_KEY) {
    try{
      const client = new OpenAI({ apiKey: OPENAI_API_KEY });
      const res = await client.audio.speech.create({
        model: "gpt-4o-mini-tts",
        voice: "alloy",
        input: text,
        format: "mp3"
      });
      const buf = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
      fs.writeFileSync(outMp3Path, buf);
      return outMp3Path;
    }catch(e){
      warn("OpenAI TTS error:", e?.message || e);
    }
  }

  // 2.3 Windows SAPI → WAV, then MP3
  const txtPath = path.join(TMP, "tts.txt");
  const wavPath = path.join(TMP, "tts.wav");
  fs.writeFileSync(txtPath, text, "utf8");

  await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
    const ps = spawn("pwsh", ["-NoProfile","-Command", `
      Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Speech;
      $s=New-Object System.Speech.Synthesis.SpeechSynthesizer;
      $s.Rate=0; $s.Volume=100;
      try { $s.SelectVoice('Microsoft David Desktop'); } catch {}
      $s.SetOutputToWaveFile('${wavPath.replace(/\\/g,"/")}');
      $t=[IO.File]::ReadAllText('${txtPath.replace(/\\/g,"/")}');
      $s.Speak($t); $s.Dispose();
    `], {stdio:["ignore","inherit","inherit"]});
    ps.on("close",(c)=> c===0 ? resolve() : reject(new Error("SAPI TTS failed")));
  });

  await runFFmpeg(["-y","-i", wavPath, "-codec:a","libmp3lame","-b:a","128k", outMp3Path]);
  return outMp3Path;
}

// ---------- 3) Render (waveform + optional BG video/image + optional logo + (optional) burned subtitles) ----------
async function renderVideo(audioPath, srtPath, outPath, durationSec){
  const dur = Math.max(10, Math.ceil(durationSec));
  const [W,H] = CANVAS_SIZE.split("x").map(n=>parseInt(n,10));
  const bgMp4 = path.join(ROOT, "assets", "bg.mp4");
  const bgImg = path.join(ROOT, "assets", "bg.jpg");
  const hasLogo = fs.existsSync(LOGO_PATH);

  const wave = `[0:a]showwaves=s=${W}x${WAVE_HEIGHT}:mode=cline:rate=25:colors=FFFFFF@0.9,format=rgba[wave];`;
  const logoPrep = hasLogo ? `[2:v]scale=720:-1:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,format=rgba[logo];` : "";

  let args = ["-y", "-i", audioPath];
  let filter = wave;

  const overlayY = Math.max(0, H - WAVE_HEIGHT - WAVE_MARGIN_BOTTOM);

  // subtitles style
  const style = "FontName=Arial,Fontsize=54,PrimaryColour=&H00FFFFFF&,OutlineColour=&H000000&,BorderStyle=1,Outline=2,Shadow=0,Alignment=2,MarginV=80";
  const subFilter = `subtitles='${safeForFFmpegSubPath(srtPath)}':force_style='${style}'`;

  const wantSubs = !DISABLE_SUBTITLES;

  if (!wantSubs) {
    log("Subtitles disabled (DISABLE_SUBTITLES=1). Rendering without burned captions.");
  }

  if (fs.existsSync(bgMp4)) {
    args.push("-stream_loop","-1","-t", String(dur), "-i", bgMp4);
    if (hasLogo) args.push("-i", LOGO_PATH);

    filter +=
      `[1:v]scale=${W}:${H}:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=${W}:${H},setsar=1[vbg];` +
      `[vbg][wave]overlay=(W-w)/2:${overlayY}[v1];` +
      (hasLogo ? logoPrep + `[v1][logo]overlay=(W-w)/2:(H-h)/2[v2];` : "");

    if (wantSubs) {
      filter += `[${hasLogo ? "v2" : "v1"}]${subFilter}[vout]`;
    } else {
      filter += `[${hasLogo ? "v2" : "v1"}]format=rgba[vout]`;
    }

    args.push(
      "-filter_complex", filter,
      "-map", "[vout]", "-map", "0:a",
      "-c:v","libx264","-pix_fmt","yuv420p","-r","30",
      "-c:a","aac","-b:a","128k",
      "-shortest",
      outPath
    );

  } else if (fs.existsSync(bgImg)) {
    args.push("-loop","1","-t", String(dur), "-i", bgImg);
    if (hasLogo) args.push("-i", LOGO_PATH);

    filter +=
      `[1:v]scale=${W}:${H}:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=${W}:${H},setsar=1[vbg];` +
      `[vbg][wave]overlay=(W-w)/2:${overlayY}[v1];` +
      (hasLogo ? logoPrep + `[v1][logo]overlay=(W-w)/2:(H-h)/2[v2];` : "");

    if (wantSubs) {
      filter += `[${hasLogo ? "v2" : "v1"}]${subFilter}[vout]`;
    } else {
      filter += `[${hasLogo ? "v2" : "v1"}]format=rgba[vout]`;
    }

    args.push(
      "-filter_complex", filter,
      "-map", "[vout]", "-map", "0:a",
      "-c:v","libx264","-pix_fmt","yuv420p","-r","30",
      "-c:a","aac","-b:a","128k",
      "-shortest",
      outPath
    );

  } else {
    args.push("-f","lavfi","-t", String(dur), "-i", `color=c=${BG_COLOR_HEX}:s=${CANVAS_SIZE}`);
    if (hasLogo) args.push("-i", LOGO_PATH);

    filter +=
      `[1:v]format=rgba[vbg];` +
      `[vbg][wave]overlay=(W-w)/2:${overlayY}[v1];` +
      (hasLogo ? logoPrep + `[v1][logo]overlay=(W-w)/2:(H-h)/2[v2];` : "");

    if (wantSubs) {
      filter += `[${hasLogo ? "v2" : "v1"}]${subFilter}[vout]`;
    } else {
      filter += `[${hasLogo ? "v2" : "v1"}]format=rgba[vout]`;
    }

    args.push(
      "-filter_complex", filter,
      "-map", "[vout]", "-map", "0:a",
      "-c:v","libx264","-pix_fmt","yuv420p","-r","30",
      "-c:a","aac","-b:a","128k",
      "-shortest",
      outPath
    );
  }

  // If subtitles enabled and it fails, retry without subs.
  try {
    await runFFmpeg(args);
  } catch(e) {
    if (!wantSubs) throw e;

    warn("Subtitle render failed, retrying without subtitles. Reason:", e?.message || e);

    const i = args.indexOf("-filter_complex");
    if (i > -1) {
      let f = args[i+1];
      // Replace subtitles chain with format
      f = f.replace(/\](subtitles=)'[^']*':force_style='[^']*'\[vout\]/, "]format=rgba[vout]");
      args[i+1] = f;
    }
    await runFFmpeg(args);
  }
}

// ---------- YouTube token bootstrap ----------
async function ensureYouTubeToken(oauth2){
  if (fs.existsSync(TOKEN_PATH)) {
    const tok = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(TOKEN_PATH, "utf8"));
    oauth2.setCredentials(tok);
    return;
  }

  log("YouTube OAuth token not found. Starting one-time authorization flow...");
  const scopes = ["https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.upload"];
  const authUrl = oauth2.generateAuthUrl({
    access_type: "offline",
    scope: scopes,
    prompt: "consent",
  });

  console.log("\n=== YOUTUBE AUTH REQUIRED ===");
  console.log("1) Open this URL in your browser:\n");
  console.log(authUrl);
  console.log("\n2) Approve, then copy the 'code' parameter from the redirected URL.\n");

  const code = await ask("Paste code here: ");
  if (!code) throw new Error("OAuth code boş geldi.");

  const { tokens } = await oauth2.getToken(code);
  oauth2.setCredentials(tokens);

  ensureDirForFile(TOKEN_PATH);
  fs.writeFileSync(TOKEN_PATH, JSON.stringify(tokens, null, 2), "utf8");
  log("Saved new token to:", TOKEN_PATH);
}

// ---------- 4) Upload (googleapis) ----------
async function uploadToYouTube(filePath, title, desc, privacy){
  assertFile(SECRET_PATH, "YOUTUBE_CLIENT_SECRET_PATH");

  const sec = readYouTubeClientSecret(SECRET_PATH);
  const redirectUri = (process.env.GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI || "http://localhost").trim();
  const oauth2 = new google.auth.OAuth2(sec.client_id, sec.client_secret, redirectUri);

  await ensureYouTubeToken(oauth2);

  const youtube = google.youtube({ version:"v3", auth: oauth2 });

  // --- Schedule logic ---
  let status = { privacyStatus: privacy };

  if (SCHEDULE_ENABLED) {
    const publishAt = buildPublishAtISO();
    // YouTube scheduled publish uses privacyStatus=private + publishAt
    status = {
      privacyStatus: "private",
      publishAt
    };
    log("YouTube schedule ON -> publishAt:", publishAt, "(privacyStatus=private until publish)");
  }

  const res = await youtube.videos.insert({
    part: ["snippet","status"],
    requestBody: {
      snippet: { title, description: desc },
      status
    },
    media: { body: fs.createReadStream(filePath) }
  });

  return `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=${res.data.id}`;
}

// ---------- MAIN ----------
(async () => {
  try {
    if (!await checkCmd("ffmpeg")) warn("ffmpeg bulunamadı; PATH'e ekli olduğundan emin ol.");
    if (!await checkCmd("ffprobe")) warn("ffprobe bulunamadı; PATH'e ekli olduğundan emin ol.");

    log("Generating topic & script...");
    const gen = await makeScript();
    log("Title:", gen.title);

    const voicePath = path.join(TMP, "short-voice.mp3");
    log("TTS...");
    await makeTTS(gen.script, voicePath);

    log("ffprobe duration...");
    const dur = await runFFprobeDuration(voicePath);
    log("Audio duration:", dur.toFixed(2), "s");

    let srtPath = path.join(TMP, "shorts.srt");
    if (!DISABLE_SUBTITLES) {
      log("Build SRT...");
      const cues = splitCaptions(gen.script, dur);
      const srt = toSrt(cues);
      fs.writeFileSync(srtPath, srt, "utf8");
    } else {
      // still provide a path, renderVideo won't burn if DISABLE_SUBTITLES=1
      fs.writeFileSync(srtPath, "", "utf8");
    }

    const outPath = path.join(TMP, "shorts-out.mp4");
    log("Rendering video...");
    await renderVideo(voicePath, srtPath, outPath, dur);

    const hashtags = Array.isArray(gen.hashtags) ? gen.hashtags.join(" ") : "#shorts #crypto #QuantumCoin";
    const desc = `${gen.description}\n\n${hashtags}`;

    log("Uploading to YouTube...", SCHEDULE_ENABLED ? "(scheduled)" : PRIVACY);
    const url = await uploadToYouTube(outPath, gen.title, desc, PRIVACY);

    console.log("\n=== DONE ===");
    console.log("Video:", outPath);
    console.log("YouTube:", url);

    // Optional announce (Telegram + X) - your existing publish-all.ps1 flow
    if ((process.env.ENABLE_ANNOUNCE || "").toString().trim() === "1") {
      const announce = `New Shorts: ${gen.title} ${url} #shorts #crypto`;
      try {
        await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          const ps = spawn(
            "pwsh",
            [
              "-ExecutionPolicy","Bypass",
              "-File", path.join(ROOT, "publish-all.ps1"),
              "-Text", announce,
              "-Platforms", "telegram,x",
            ],
            { stdio: "inherit" }
          );
          ps.on("close", (code) => code === 0 ? resolve() : reject(new Error("publish-all.ps1 exit " + code)));
        });
      } catch (annErr) {
        console.error("Announce failed:", annErr?.message || annErr);
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("FATAL:", e?.response?.data || e?.message || e);
    process.exit(1);
  }
})();

3) ŞİMDİ TEK KOMUTLA DENEME (SLOT 1 → 18:00, Planlı)

Bu komut YouTube’u planlar, altyazıyı kapatır, sonra da paylaşır (Telegram/X) — YouTube video “Scheduled” olur:

powershell
cd C:\Projects\quantumcoin\autopublisher; $env:QC_TODAY=(Get-Date).ToString('yyyy-MM-dd'); $env:QC_SLOT='1'; $env:QC_TZ_OFFSET='+03:00'; $env:DISABLE_SUBTITLES='1'; $env:YOUTUBE_SCHEDULE='1'; node --env-file=.env .\scripts\make-shorts.mjs

SLOT 2 (21:00) için:

powershell
cd C:\Projects\quantumcoin\autopublisher; $env:QC_TODAY=(Get-Date).ToString('yyyy-MM-dd'); $env:QC_SLOT='2'; $env:QC_TZ_OFFSET='+03:00'; $env:DISABLE_SUBTITLES='1'; $env:YOUTUBE_SCHEDULE='1'; node --env-file=.env .\scripts\make-shorts.mjs

ÖNEMLİ NOT (YouTube “Scheduled” mantığı)

Planlı yayın için YouTube API privacyStatus=private ister. Video plan saati gelince yayına alınır (Studio’da “Scheduled” görünür).

Şimdi: Yukarıdaki SLOT 1 komutunu çalıştır, çıktıyı (özellikle publishAt: satırını ve YouTube linkini) buraya yapıştır.

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest $ErrorActionPreference='Stop' $root='C:\Projects\quantumcoin\autopublisher' Set-Location $root # Node PATH (Task Scheduler PATH boş olabiliyor) $nodeDir='C:\Program Files\nodejs' if (Test-Path $nodeDir){ $env:Path="$nodeDir;$env:Path" } # Basit log $logDir = Join-Path $root 'logs' New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $logDir | Out-Null $log = Join-Path $logDir ("sched-" + (Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss") + ".log") function LOG([string]$m){ ("[{0}] {1}" -f (Get-Date -Format "HH:mm:ss"),$m) | Tee-Object -FilePath $log -Append | Out-Null } # .env yükle Get-Content .\.env | ? {$_ -match '^\s*[^#]'} | % { $k,$v = $_ -split '=',2; [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($k,$v,'Process') } LOG "ENV loaded" # OUT klasörü garanti New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path .\src\content\out | Out-Null $lastJson=".\src\content\out\last.json" # İçeriği üret (child process env devralır; --env-file'a gerek yok) LOG "gen-content start" $nodeOut = & node .\scripts\gen-content.mjs 2>&1 $exit=$LASTEXITCODE $nodeOut | Set-Content -Path $lastJson -Encoding UTF8 if($exit -ne 0){ LOG ("gen-content ERR: " + ($nodeOut -join ' ' -replace '\s+',' ')); exit 2 } try { $p = (Get-Content $lastJson -Raw) | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { LOG ("json parse ERR: " + $_.Exception.Message); exit 2 } LOG "gen-content OK" # Telegram try { & pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\publish-all.ps1 -Text $p.telegram -Platforms telegram LOG "telegram exit=$LASTEXITCODE" } catch { LOG ("telegram ERR: " + $_.Exception.Message); exit 2 } Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 # X (test/ek yok) $xt = $p.x try { & pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\publish-all.ps1 -Text $xt -Platforms x LOG "x exit=$LASTEXITCODE" } catch { LOG ("x ERR: " + $_.Exception.Message); exit 2 } LOG "DONE" dosyanın tamamı

3) run-daily.ps1 — baştan sona doğru hali (kopyala/yapıştır ile değiştir)

Aşağıdakini C:\Projects\quantumcoin\autopublisher\run-daily.ps1 içine komple yapıştırıp kaydet:

powershell
param(
  [Parameter(Position=0)]
  [int]$Slot = 1
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$root = 'C:\Projects\quantumcoin\autopublisher'
Set-Location $root

# Node PATH (Task Scheduler'da PATH boş olabiliyor)
$nodeDir = 'C:\Program Files\nodejs'
if (Test-Path $nodeDir) { $env:Path = "$nodeDir;$env:Path" }

# Log setup
$logDir = Join-Path $root 'logs'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $logDir | Out-Null
$log = Join-Path $logDir ("sched-" + (Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss") + "-slot$Slot.log")

function LOG([string]$m){
  $line = ("[{0}] {1}" -f (Get-Date -Format "HH:mm:ss"), $m)
  Add-Content -Path $log -Value $line -Encoding UTF8
  Write-Host $line
}

try {
  LOG "START slot=$Slot"

  # .env yükle (SADECE KEY=VALUE satırları)
  $envFile = Join-Path $root '.env'
  if (-not (Test-Path $envFile)) { throw ".env not found at $envFile" }

  Get-Content $envFile | ForEach-Object {
    $line = $_.Trim()
    if (-not $line) { return }
    if ($line.StartsWith('#')) { return }
    if ($line -notmatch '^\s*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=\s*(.*)\s*$') { return }

    $k = $Matches[1]
    $v = $Matches[2]

    # strip optional quotes
    if ($v.StartsWith('"') -and $v.EndsWith('"')) { $v = $v.Substring(1, $v.Length-2) }
    if ($v.StartsWith("'") -and $v.EndsWith("'")) { $v = $v.Substring(1, $v.Length-2) }

    [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($k, $v, 'Process')
  }

  LOG "ENV loaded"

  # Slot / gün / timezone / flags
  $env:QC_TODAY = (Get-Date).ToString('yyyy-MM-dd')
  $env:QC_SLOT  = "$Slot"
  if (-not $env:QC_TZ_OFFSET) { $env:QC_TZ_OFFSET = '+03:00' }

  # İsteğe bağlı ayarlar (senin mevcut düzenin)
  if (-not $env:DISABLE_SUBTITLES) { $env:DISABLE_SUBTITLES = '1' }   # alt yazı yakma kapalı
  if (-not $env:YOUTUBE_SCHEDULE)  { $env:YOUTUBE_SCHEDULE  = '1' }   # publishAt ile zamanla
  if (-not $env:ENABLE_ANNOUNCE)   { $env:ENABLE_ANNOUNCE   = '1' }   # Telegram+X duyuru

  # Shorts üret + YouTube upload (+ announce Telegram/X)
  LOG "RUN make-shorts.mjs"
  $out = & node .\scripts\make-shorts.mjs 2>&1
  $code = $LASTEXITCODE

  # çıktı log'a
  $out | ForEach-Object { Add-Content -Path $log -Value $_ -Encoding UTF8 }

  if ($code -ne 0) {
    LOG "ERROR make-shorts exit=$code"
    exit 2
  }

  LOG "DONE OK"
  exit 0
}
catch {
  LOG ("FATAL: " + $_.Exception.Message)
  exit 2
}

powershell
param(
  [Parameter(Position=0)]
  [ValidateSet('1','2')]
  [string]$Slot = '1'
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$root = 'C:\Projects\quantumcoin\autopublisher'
Set-Location $root

# ----------------------------
# Logging (ALWAYS write header)
# ----------------------------
$logDir = Join-Path $root 'logs'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $logDir | Out-Null
$log = Join-Path $logDir ("sched-" + (Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss") + "-slot$Slot.log")

function LOG([string]$m){
  ("[{0}] {1}" -f (Get-Date -Format "HH:mm:ss"), $m) | Out-File -FilePath $log -Append -Encoding UTF8
}

# write header immediately (prevents 0-byte logs)
LOG "START slot=$Slot user=$env:USERNAME computer=$env:COMPUTERNAME pwd=$(Get-Location)"

try {
  # ----------------------------
  # Ensure Node in PATH (Task Scheduler often has empty PATH)
  # ----------------------------
  $nodeDir = 'C:\Program Files\nodejs'
  if (Test-Path $nodeDir) { $env:Path = "$nodeDir;$env:Path" }

  # Quick sanity (helps debug)
  try {
    $nodeV = (& node -v 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim()
    LOG "node=$nodeV"
  } catch {
    LOG "ERROR: node not runnable. PATH=$env:Path"
    throw
  }

  # ----------------------------
  # Load .env into Process env
  # (keeps your existing behavior)
  # ----------------------------
  if (-not (Test-Path ".\.env")) { throw ".env not found in $root" }

  Get-Content .\.env |
    Where-Object { $_ -match '^\s*[^#]'} |
    ForEach-Object {
      $k, $v = $_ -split '=', 2
      if ($null -ne $k -and $k.Trim().Length -gt 0) {
        [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($k.Trim(), ($v ?? '').Trim(), 'Process')
      }
    }

  LOG "ENV loaded from .env"

  # ----------------------------
  # Compute today + timezone (Turkey +03:00)
  # ----------------------------

  $env:QC_SLOT  = $Slot
  if (-not $env:QC_TZ_OFFSET -or $env:QC_TZ_OFFSET.Trim() -eq '') {
    $env:QC_TZ_OFFSET = '+03:00'
  }

  # You requested: no burned subtitles
  $env:DISABLE_SUBTITLES = '1'

  # You requested: scheduled publish (private until publishAt)
  $env:YOUTUBE_SCHEDULE = '1'

  # If you want announce from make-shorts itself (optional)
  # Keep 0 by default because we already announce below in this script.
  if (-not $env:ENABLE_ANNOUNCE -or $env:ENABLE_ANNOUNCE.Trim() -eq '') {
    $env:ENABLE_ANNOUNCE = '0'
  }

  LOG ("vars: QC_TODAY={0} QC_SLOT={1} QC_TZ_OFFSET={2} DISABLE_SUBTITLES={3} YOUTUBE_SCHEDULE={4}" -f `
    $env:QC_TODAY, $env:QC_SLOT, $env:QC_TZ_OFFSET, $env:DISABLE_SUBTITLES, $env:YOUTUBE_SCHEDULE)

  # ----------------------------
  # 1) Run make-shorts (this generates + uploads YouTube)
  # ----------------------------
  LOG "make-shorts start"
  $msOut = & node .\scripts\make-shorts.mjs 2>&1
  $msExit = $LASTEXITCODE
  ($msOut | Out-String).TrimEnd() | Out-File -FilePath $log -Append -Encoding UTF8

  if ($msExit -ne 0) {
    LOG "make-shorts FAILED exit=$msExit"
    exit 2
  }
  LOG "make-shorts OK"

  # ----------------------------
  # 2) Read last.json created by make-shorts (topic/script)
  # We assume your scripts already write:
  #   src/content/out/last.json
  # ----------------------------
  $lastJson = ".\src\content\out\last.json"

    LOG "WARN: last.json not found at $lastJson (announce will be generic)"

      $p = (Get-Content $lastJson -Raw) | ConvertFrom-Json
      $title = $p.title
      LOG "last.json OK title=$title"
    }
  } catch {
    LOG ("WARN: last.json parse ERR: " + $_.Exception.Message)
  }

  # ----------------------------
  # 3) Optional: announce Telegram + X (keeps your existing publish-all.ps1 usage)
  # If you want "team posts won't break schedule": Scheduler just runs anyway.
  # ----------------------------
  $doAnnounce = $true
  if ($env:DISABLE_ANNOUNCE -and $env:DISABLE_ANNOUNCE.Trim() -eq '1') {
    $doAnnounce = $false
    LOG "announce disabled (DISABLE_ANNOUNCE=1)"
  }

  if ($doAnnounce) {
    # If last.json has prepared texts, use them; else fall back.
    $tgText = $null
    $xText  = $null

    try {
      if ($p -and $p.telegram) { $tgText = $p.telegram }
      if ($p -and $p.x)       { $xText  = $p.x }
    } catch {}

    if (-not $tgText) { $tgText = "New QuantumCoin update (slot $Slot) — check YouTube @QuantumCoinHQ" }
    if (-not $xText)  { $xText  = "QuantumCoin daily update (slot $Slot) — YouTube @QuantumCoinHQ #crypto #shorts" }

      & pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\publish-all.ps1 -Text $tgText -Platforms telegram
      LOG "telegram exit=$LASTEXITCODE"
    } catch {
      LOG ("telegram ERR: " + $_.Exception.Message)
      exit 2
    }

    try {
      LOG "x announce start"
      & pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\publish-all.ps1 -Text $xText -Platforms x
      LOG "x exit=$LASTEXITCODE"
    } catch {
      LOG ("x ERR: " + $_.Exception.Message)
      exit 2
    }
  }

  LOG "DONE OK"
  exit 0
}
catch {
  LOG ("FATAL: " + $_.Exception.Message)
  LOG ("STACK: " + ($_.ScriptStackTrace -replace "`r?`n", " | "))
  exit 2
}

  # Duplicate ise 1 kere daha farklı bir saniye etiketi ile dene
  if ($msg -match 'duplicate content') {
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    $suffix2 = " • " + $env:QC_TODAY + " S" + $env:QC_SLOT + " " + (Get-Date -Format "HHmmss")
    $maxBase2 = 280 - $suffix2.Length
    $xt2 = $xt
    # xt zaten suffixli, onu base olarak tekrar kesip ekleyelim
    $base = $xt2.Split("•")[0].TrimEnd()
    if ($base.Length -gt $maxBase2) { $base = $base.Substring(0, $maxBase2) }
    $xt2 = $base + $suffix2

    try {
      & pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\publish-all.ps1 -Text $xt2 -Platforms x
      LOG "x retry OK exit=$LASTEXITCODE"
    } catch {
      LOG ("x retry ERR: " + $_.Exception.Message)
      exit 2
    }
  } else {
    exit 2
  }
}

✅ GÜNCELLENMİŞ run-daily.ps1 (FINAL)

powershell
param(
  [Parameter(Position=0)]
  [ValidateSet('1','2')]
  [string]$Slot = '1'
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$root = 'C:\Projects\quantumcoin\autopublisher'
Set-Location $root

# =====================================================
# LOGGING (0-byte log KESİNLİKLE OLMASIN)
# =====================================================
$logDir = Join-Path $root 'logs'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $logDir | Out-Null

$log = Join-Path $logDir ("sched-" + (Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss") + "-slot$Slot.log")

function LOG([string]$m){
  ("[{0}] {1}" -f (Get-Date -Format "HH:mm:ss"), $m) |
    Out-File -FilePath $log -Append -Encoding UTF8
}

LOG "START slot=$Slot user=$env:USERNAME computer=$env:COMPUTERNAME pwd=$(Get-Location)"

try {

  # =====================================================
  # NODE PATH (Task Scheduler PATH boş olabiliyor)
  # =====================================================
  $nodeDir = 'C:\Program Files\nodejs'
  if (Test-Path $nodeDir) { $env:Path = "$nodeDir;$env:Path" }

  try {
    $nodeV = (& node -v 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim()
    LOG "node=$nodeV"
  } catch {
    LOG "ERROR: Node not runnable. PATH=$env:Path"
    throw
  }

  # =====================================================
  # .env YÜKLE
  # =====================================================
  if (-not (Test-Path ".\.env")) {
    throw ".env not found"
  }

  Get-Content .\.env |
    Where-Object { $_ -match '^\s*[^#]' } |
    ForEach-Object {
      $k,$v = $_ -split '=',2
      if ($k) {
        [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable(
          $k.Trim(),
          ($v ?? '').Trim(),
          'Process'
        )
      }
    }

  LOG "ENV loaded from .env"

  # =====================================================
  # ZAMAN / SLOT / BAYRAKLAR
  # =====================================================
  $env:QC_TODAY = (Get-Date).ToString('yyyy-MM-dd')
  $env:QC_SLOT  = $Slot
  if (-not $env:QC_TZ_OFFSET) { $env:QC_TZ_OFFSET = '+03:00' }

  $env:DISABLE_SUBTITLES = '1'
  $env:YOUTUBE_SCHEDULE = '1'
  if (-not $env:ENABLE_ANNOUNCE) { $env:ENABLE_ANNOUNCE = '0' }

  LOG "vars: QC_TODAY=$env:QC_TODAY SLOT=$env:QC_SLOT TZ=$env:QC_TZ_OFFSET"

  # =====================================================
  # 1) YOUTUBE SHORTS ÜRET + YÜKLE
  # =====================================================
  LOG "make-shorts start"
  $msOut = & node .\scripts\make-shorts.mjs 2>&1
  $msExit = $LASTEXITCODE

  ($msOut | Out-String).TrimEnd() |
    Out-File -FilePath $log -Append -Encoding UTF8

  if ($msExit -ne 0) {
    LOG "make-shorts FAILED exit=$msExit"
    exit 2
  }

  LOG "make-shorts OK"

  # =====================================================
  # 2) last.json OKU
  # =====================================================
  $lastJson = ".\src\content\out\last.json"
  $p = $null

  if (Test-Path $lastJson) {
    try {
      $p = (Get-Content $lastJson -Raw) | ConvertFrom-Json
      LOG "last.json OK title=$($p.title)"
    } catch {
      LOG "WARN: last.json parse failed"
    }
  } else {
    LOG "WARN: last.json missing"
  }

  # =====================================================
  # 3) TELEGRAM + X DUYURU
  # =====================================================
  if (-not ($env:DISABLE_ANNOUNCE -eq '1')) {

    # -------- Telegram --------
    $tgText = if ($p -and $p.telegram) {
      $p.telegram
    } else {
      "New QuantumCoin update (slot $Slot) — YouTube @QuantumCoinHQ"
    }

    LOG "telegram announce start"
    & pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass `
      -File .\publish-all.ps1 `
      -Text $tgText `
      -Platforms telegram

    LOG "telegram exit=$LASTEXITCODE"
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2

    # -------- X (DUPLICATE-SAFE) --------
    $baseX = if ($p -and $p.x) {
      [string]$p.x
    } else {
      "QuantumCoin daily update — YouTube @QuantumCoinHQ #crypto #shorts"
    }

    # HER PAYLAŞIMI BENZERSİZ YAP
    $suffix = " • $env:QC_TODAY S$Slot"
    $maxLen = 280 - $suffix.Length
    if ($baseX.Length -gt $maxLen) {
      $baseX = $baseX.Substring(0,$maxLen)
    }
    $xText = $baseX + $suffix

    try {
      LOG "x announce start"
      & pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass `
        -File .\publish-all.ps1 `
        -Text $xText `
        -Platforms x

      LOG "x exit=$LASTEXITCODE"
    }
    catch {
      LOG ("x ERR: " + $_.Exception.Message)

      # DUPLICATE ise 1 kez retry
      if ($_.Exception.Message -match 'duplicate') {
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
        $suffix2 = " • $env:QC_TODAY S$Slot " + (Get-Date -Format "HHmmss")
        $maxLen2 = 280 - $suffix2.Length
        if ($baseX.Length -gt $maxLen2) {
          $baseX = $baseX.Substring(0,$maxLen2)
        }
        $xRetry = $baseX + $suffix2

        LOG "x retry start"
        & pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass `
          -File .\publish-all.ps1 `
          -Text $xRetry `
          -Platforms x

        LOG "x retry exit=$LASTEXITCODE"
      } else {
        exit 2
      }
    }
  }

  LOG "DONE OK"
  exit 0
}
catch {
  LOG ("FATAL: " + $_.Exception.Message)
  LOG ("STACK: " + ($_.ScriptStackTrace -replace "`r?`n"," | "))
  exit 2
}

1) “Weekly content health report” ne demek?

Bu, otomasyonun sağlıklı çalışıp çalışmadığını haftada 1 kez özetleyen rapor dosyası (ve istersen Telegram’a kısa mesaj) demek. Şunları toplar:

  • Bu hafta kaç içerik üretildi / paylaşıldı (YouTube, X, Telegram, IG, TikTok)

  • Başarı oranı: kaç “OK”, kaç “FAIL”

  • En sık hata nedenleri (duplicate, rate limit, API auth, upload fail)

  • Son 7 günün linkleri (YouTube URL / tweet id / telegram message id / IG reel url / TikTok url)

  • Tekrar kontrolü (aynı başlık/konu çok sık mı dönüyor)

  • Ortalama video süresi / render süresi (istersek)

Bunun amacı: “365 gün kusursuz döngü” hedefinde erken uyarı sistemi.

Seçenek A (en stabil / önerilen): “Dosya tabanlı kuyruk”

  • make-shorts.mjs üretir: tmp/shorts-out.mp4

  • run-daily.ps1 bunu outbox/ig/ ve outbox/tiktok/ klasörlerine kopyalar

  • IG/TikTok upload ayrı script’lerle yapılır (API yoksa bile “manual uploader” gibi çalışır)

Aşağıdaki komut weekly-report.ps1 dosyasını oluşturur ve haftalık görev ekler. (tek parça)

PowerShell’e aynen yapıştır:

powershell
$root="C:\Projects\quantumcoin\autopublisher"
$rep = @'
Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"

$root="C:\Projects\quantumcoin\autopublisher"
Set-Location $root

$eventsPath = Join-Path $root "logs\events.ndjson"
$reportsDir = Join-Path $root "reports"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $reportsDir | Out-Null

$now = Get-Date
$start = $now.AddDays(-7)

$events = @()
if (Test-Path $eventsPath) {
  Get-Content $eventsPath | ForEach-Object {
    try { $events += ($_ | ConvertFrom-Json) } catch {}
  }
}

# filter last 7 days
$events = $events | Where-Object {
  try {
    $t = [datetimeoffset]::Parse($_.ts)
    $t.UtcDateTime -ge $start.ToUniversalTime()
  } catch { $false }
}

function CountOK($name){ ($events | Where-Object { $_.$name -eq "OK" }).Count }
function CountFAIL($name){ ($events | Where-Object { $_.$name -eq "FAIL" }).Count }
function CountSKIP($name){ ($events | Where-Object { $_.$name -eq "SKIP" }).Count }

$ytOk=CountOK "youtube"; $ytFail=CountFAIL "youtube"
$tgOk=CountOK "telegram"; $tgFail=CountFAIL "telegram"
$xOk=CountOK "x"; $xFail=CountFAIL "x"
$igOk=CountOK "ig"; $igFail=CountFAIL "ig"
$ttOk=CountOK "tiktok"; $ttFail=CountFAIL "tiktok"

$all = $events.Count
$okAll = ($events | Where-Object { $_.overall -eq "OK" }).Count

# week id
$cal = [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture.Calendar
$week = $cal.GetWeekOfYear($now, [System.Globalization.CalendarWeekRule]::FirstFourDayWeek, [DayOfWeek]::Monday)
$year = $now.Year

$reportPath = Join-Path $reportsDir ("health-{0}-W{1}.md" -f $year, $week)

$topErrors = ($events | Where-Object { $_.error } | Group-Object error | Sort-Object Count -Descending | Select-Object -First 8)

$links = $events | Select-Object ts,slot,yt_url,tweet_id,tg_msg,ig_url,tiktok_url | Sort-Object ts -Descending | Select-Object -First 30

@"
# QuantumCoin Autopublisher — Weekly Content Health Report

**Window:** $($start.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")) → $($now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd"))
**Total runs:** $all

## Platform summary (OK / FAIL)

- YouTube:  $ytOk OK / $ytFail FAIL
- Telegram: $tgOk OK / $tgFail FAIL
- X:        $xOk OK / $xFail FAIL
- Instagram:$igOk OK / $igFail FAIL
- TikTok:   $ttOk OK / $ttFail FAIL

## Top errors (last 7 days)
$(
  if ($topErrors.Count -eq 0) { "- none" }
  else { ($topErrors | ForEach-Object { "- $($_.Name) — $($_.Count)x" }) -join "`n" }
)

## Latest links (last 30)
$(
  if ($links.Count -eq 0) { "none" }
  else {
    ($links | ForEach-Object {
      "- $($_.ts) | slot=$($_.slot) | yt=$($_.yt_url) | x=$($_.tweet_id) | tg=$($_.tg_msg) | ig=$($_.ig_url) | tt=$($_.tiktok_url)"
    }) -join "`n"
  }
)

"@ | Out-File -Encoding UTF8 -FilePath $reportPath

Write-Host "Report written: $reportPath"
'@

✅ Güncellenmiş run-daily.ps1 (tam dosya)

Bunu C:\Projects\quantumcoin\autopublisher\run-daily.ps1 üzerine komple yapıştır:

powershell
param(
  [Parameter(Position=0)]
  [ValidateSet('1','2')]
  [string]$Slot = '1'
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$root = 'C:\Projects\quantumcoin\autopublisher'
Set-Location $root

# =====================================================
# LOGGING (0-byte log KESİNLİKLE OLMASIN)
# =====================================================
$logDir = Join-Path $root 'logs'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $logDir | Out-Null
$log = Join-Path $logDir ("sched-" + (Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss") + "-slot$Slot.log")

function LOG([string]$m){
  ("[{0}] {1}" -f (Get-Date -Format "HH:mm:ss"), $m) |
    Out-File -FilePath $log -Append -Encoding UTF8
}

# hemen header yaz
LOG "START slot=$Slot user=$env:USERNAME computer=$env:COMPUTERNAME pwd=$(Get-Location)"

try {
  # =====================================================
  # NODE PATH (Task Scheduler PATH boş olabiliyor)
  # =====================================================
  $nodeDir = 'C:\Program Files\nodejs'
  if (Test-Path $nodeDir) { $env:Path = "$nodeDir;$env:Path" }

  try {
    $nodeV = (& node -v 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim()
    LOG "node=$nodeV"
  } catch {
    LOG "ERROR: Node not runnable. PATH=$env:Path"
    throw
  }

  # =====================================================
  # .env YÜKLE (Process env)
  # =====================================================
  if (-not (Test-Path ".\.env")) { throw ".env not found in $root" }

  Get-Content .\.env |
    Where-Object { $_ -match '^\s*[^#]'} |
    ForEach-Object {
      $k,$v = $_ -split '=',2
      if ($k) {
        [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($k.Trim(), ($v ?? '').Trim(), 'Process')
      }
    }

  LOG "ENV loaded from .env"

  # =====================================================
  # ZAMAN / SLOT / BAYRAKLAR (tek mod: her çalıştırma canlı)
  # =====================================================
  $env:QC_TODAY = (Get-Date).ToString('yyyy-MM-dd')
  $env:QC_SLOT  = $Slot
  if (-not $env:QC_TZ_OFFSET -or $env:QC_TZ_OFFSET.Trim() -eq '') { $env:QC_TZ_OFFSET = '+03:00' }

  # senin isteğin: altyazı YOK
  $env:DISABLE_SUBTITLES = '1'

  # senin isteğin: YouTube schedule (private until publishAt)
  $env:YOUTUBE_SCHEDULE = '1'

  # make-shorts kendi announce yapmasın (biz aşağıda 3 platformu zaten post edeceğiz)
  $env:ENABLE_ANNOUNCE = '0'

  LOG "vars: QC_TODAY=$env:QC_TODAY SLOT=$env:QC_SLOT TZ=$env:QC_TZ_OFFSET DISABLE_SUBTITLES=$env:DISABLE_SUBTITLES YOUTUBE_SCHEDULE=$env:YOUTUBE_SCHEDULE"

  # =====================================================
  # 1) YOUTUBE SHORTS ÜRET + YÜKLE
  # =====================================================
  LOG "make-shorts start"
  $msOut  = & node .\scripts\make-shorts.mjs 2>&1
  $msExit = $LASTEXITCODE

  ($msOut | Out-String).TrimEnd() | Out-File -FilePath $log -Append -Encoding UTF8

  if ($msExit -ne 0) {
    LOG "make-shorts FAILED exit=$msExit"
    exit 2
  }

  LOG "make-shorts OK"

  # =====================================================
  # 2) last.json OKU (Telegram/X metinleri buradan)
  # =====================================================
  $lastJson = ".\src\content\out\last.json"
  $p = $null

  if (Test-Path $lastJson) {
    try {
      $p = (Get-Content $lastJson -Raw) | ConvertFrom-Json
      LOG "last.json OK title=$($p.title)"
    } catch {
      LOG "WARN: last.json parse failed: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    }
  } else {
    LOG "WARN: last.json missing"
  }

  # =====================================================
  # 3) TELEGRAM (HER ÇALIŞTIRMADA)
  # =====================================================
  $tgText = if ($p -and $p.telegram) { [string]$p.telegram } else { "New QuantumCoin update (slot $Slot) — YouTube @QuantumCoinHQ" }

  LOG "telegram post start"
  & pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\publish-all.ps1 -Text $tgText -Platforms telegram
  LOG "telegram exit=$LASTEXITCODE"

  Start-Sleep -Seconds 2

  # =====================================================
  # 4) X (HER ÇALIŞTIRMADA) - DUPLICATE SAFE + 1 RETRY
  # =====================================================
  $baseX = if ($p -and $p.x) { [string]$p.x } else { "QuantumCoin daily update — YouTube @QuantumCoinHQ #crypto #shorts" }

  # her paylaşımı benzersiz yap
  $suffix = " • $env:QC_TODAY S$Slot"
  $maxLen = 280 - $suffix.Length
  if ($baseX.Length -gt $maxLen) { $baseX = $baseX.Substring(0, $maxLen) }
  $xText = $baseX + $suffix

  try {
    LOG "x post start"
    & pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\publish-all.ps1 -Text $xText -Platforms x
    LOG "x exit=$LASTEXITCODE"
  }
  catch {
    $msg = $_.Exception.Message
    LOG ("x ERR: " + $msg)

    # duplicate ise 1 kez retry
    if ($msg -match 'duplicate') {
      Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
      $suffix2 = " • $env:QC_TODAY S$Slot " + (Get-Date -Format "HHmmss")
      $maxLen2 = 280 - $suffix2.Length
      $base2 = $baseX
      if ($base2.Length -gt $maxLen2) { $base2 = $base2.Substring(0, $maxLen2) }
      $xRetry = $base2 + $suffix2

      LOG "x retry start"
      & pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\publish-all.ps1 -Text $xRetry -Platforms x
      LOG "x retry exit=$LASTEXITCODE"
    } else {
      exit 2
    }
  }

  LOG "DONE OK"
  exit 0
}
catch {
  LOG ("FATAL: " + $_.Exception.Message)
  LOG ("STACK: " + ($_.ScriptStackTrace -replace "`r?`n"," | "))
  exit 2
}

  $xText = $baseX + $suffix

    LOG "x announce start"
    & pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\publish-all.ps1 -Text $xText -Platforms x
    LOG "x exit=$LASTEXITCODE"
  }
  catch {
    LOG ("x ERR: " + $_.Exception.Message)

    if ($_.Exception.Message -match 'duplicate') {
      Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
      $suffix2 = " • $env:QC_TODAY S$Slot " + (Get-Date -Format "HHmmss")
      $maxLen2 = 280 - $suffix2.Length
      if ($baseX.Length -gt $maxLen2) { $baseX = $baseX.Substring(0,$maxLen2) }
      $xRetry = $baseX + $suffix2

      LOG "x retry start"
      & pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\publish-all.ps1 -Text $xRetry -Platforms x
      LOG "x retry exit=$LASTEXITCODE"
    } else {
      exit 2
    }
  }

  LOG "DONE OK"
  exit 0
}
catch {
  LOG ("FATAL: " + $_.Exception.Message)
  LOG ("STACK: " + ($_.ScriptStackTrace -replace "`r?`n"," | "))
  exit 2
}

Aşağıdaki tam dosyayı C:\Projects\quantumcoin\autopublisher\run-daily.ps1 içine birebir yapıştır (mevcut içeriği tamamen değiştir):

powershell
param(
  [Parameter(Position=0)]
  [ValidateSet('1','2')]
  [string]$Slot = '1'
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$root = 'C:\Projects\quantumcoin\autopublisher'
Set-Location $root

# =====================================================
# LOGGING (0-byte log ASLA OLMASIN)
# =====================================================
$logDir = Join-Path $root 'logs'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $logDir | Out-Null
$log = Join-Path $logDir ("sched-" + (Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss") + "-slot$Slot.log")

function LOG([string]$m){
  ("[{0}] {1}" -f (Get-Date -Format "HH:mm:ss"), $m) |
    Out-File -FilePath $log -Append -Encoding UTF8
}

# Konsola kısa özet (elle test ederken iyi; scheduler'a zararı yok)
function OUT([string]$m){
  Write-Host $m
  LOG $m
}

OUT "START slot=$Slot user=$env:USERNAME computer=$env:COMPUTERNAME pwd=$(Get-Location)"
OUT "log=$log"

# =====================================================
# LOCK (aynı slot aynı anda 2 kere çalışmasın)
#  - schtasks /Run'e iki kez basınca 'Running' + 267009 görüyordun
# =====================================================
$tmpDir = Join-Path $root 'tmp'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $tmpDir | Out-Null
$lockPath = Join-Path $tmpDir ("slot$Slot.lock")

$lockStream = $null
try {
  # FileShare.None => kilitliyse burada patlar
  $lockStream = [System.IO.File]::Open($lockPath, 'OpenOrCreate', 'ReadWrite', 'None')
  $lockStream.SetLength(0)
  $stamp = "pid=$PID time=" + (Get-Date).ToString("s")
  $bytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($stamp)
  $lockStream.Write($bytes,0,$bytes.Length)
  $lockStream.Flush()
  OUT "lock acquired ($lockPath)"
} catch {
  OUT "LOCKED: slot$Slot already running -> exiting safely."
  exit 0
}

try {
  # =====================================================
  # NODE PATH (Task Scheduler PATH boş olabiliyor)
  # =====================================================
  $nodeDir = 'C:\Program Files\nodejs'
  if (Test-Path $nodeDir) { $env:Path = "$nodeDir;$env:Path" }

  try {
    $nodeV = (& node -v 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim()
    OUT "node=$nodeV"
  } catch {
    OUT "ERROR: Node not runnable. PATH=$env:Path"
    throw
  }

  # =====================================================
  # .env YÜKLE (Process env)
  # =====================================================
  if (-not (Test-Path ".\.env")) { throw ".env not found in $root" }

  Get-Content .\.env |
    Where-Object { $_ -match '^\s*[^#]' } |
    ForEach-Object {
      $k,$v = $_ -split '=',2
      if ($k -and $k.Trim().Length -gt 0) {
        [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($k.Trim(), ($v ?? '').Trim(), 'Process')
      }
    }

  OUT "ENV loaded from .env"

  # =====================================================
  # PLATFORM SEÇİMİ
  # - Varsayılan: youtube,telegram,x (tam otomasyon)
  # - QC_PLATFORMS='youtube' gibi verirsen sadece onu çalıştırır.
  # - Sen “hepsi aynı anda” dediğin için default zaten full.
  # =====================================================
  $plats = @('youtube','telegram','x')

  if ($env:QC_PLATFORMS -and $env:QC_PLATFORMS.Trim() -ne '') {
    $plats = ($env:QC_PLATFORMS -split '[,; ]+' | Where-Object { $_ -and $_.Trim() -ne '' } | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim().ToLower() })
  }

  # İstersen QC_FORCE_ALL=1 ile QC_PLATFORMS'i yok sayıp hep full çalıştır
  if ($env:QC_FORCE_ALL -and $env:QC_FORCE_ALL.Trim() -eq '1') {
    $plats = @('youtube','telegram','x')
  }

  OUT ("platforms=" + ($plats -join ','))

  # =====================================================
  # ZAMAN / SLOT / BAYRAKLAR
  # =====================================================
  if (-not $env:QC_TODAY -or $env:QC_TODAY.Trim() -eq '') { $env:QC_TODAY = (Get-Date).ToString('yyyy-MM-dd') }
  $env:QC_SLOT = $Slot
  if (-not $env:QC_TZ_OFFSET -or $env:QC_TZ_OFFSET.Trim() -eq '') { $env:QC_TZ_OFFSET = '+03:00' }

  # İsteklerin:
  $env:DISABLE_SUBTITLES = '1'     # altyazı yakma kapalı
  if (-not $env:YOUTUBE_SCHEDULE -or $env:YOUTUBE_SCHEDULE.Trim() -eq '') { $env:YOUTUBE_SCHEDULE = '1' }

  OUT "vars: QC_TODAY=$env:QC_TODAY QC_SLOT=$env:QC_SLOT QC_TZ_OFFSET=$env:QC_TZ_OFFSET DISABLE_SUBTITLES=$env:DISABLE_SUBTITLES YOUTUBE_SCHEDULE=$env:YOUTUBE_SCHEDULE"

  # =====================================================
  # 1) YOUTUBE SHORTS ÜRET + YÜKLE
  # =====================================================
  $msText = ""
  $title = $null
  $ytUrl = $null

  if ($plats -contains 'youtube') {
    OUT "make-shorts start"
    $msOut = & node .\scripts\make-shorts.mjs 2>&1
    $msExit = $LASTEXITCODE

    $msText = ($msOut | Out-String).TrimEnd()
    $msText | Out-File -FilePath $log -Append -Encoding UTF8

    if ($msExit -ne 0) {
      OUT "make-shorts FAILED exit=$msExit"
      exit 2
    }

    OUT "make-shorts OK"

    # Title parse (best-effort)
    $tLine = ($msText -split "`r?`n" | Where-Object { $_ -match '^\[make-shorts\]\s*Title:\s*(.+)$' } | Select-Object -Last 1)
    if ($tLine) {
      $title = ($tLine -replace '^\[make-shorts\]\s*Title:\s*','').Trim()
    }

    # YouTube URL parse (best-effort)
    $yLine = ($msText -split "`r?`n" | Where-Object { $_ -match '^YouTube:\s+https?://www\.youtube\.com/watch\?v=' } | Select-Object -Last 1)
    if ($yLine) {
      $ytUrl = ($yLine -replace '^YouTube:\s*','').Trim()
    }

    OUT ("parsed: title=" + ($title ?? '<null>') + " yt=" + ($ytUrl ?? '<null>'))
  }

  # =====================================================
  # 2) last.json OKU (varsa) + yoksa oluştur
  # =====================================================
  $lastJson = ".\src\content\out\last.json"
  $p = $null

  if (Test-Path $lastJson) {
    try {
      $p = (Get-Content $lastJson -Raw) | ConvertFrom-Json
      OUT "last.json OK"
    } catch {
      OUT "WARN: last.json parse failed"
    }
  } else {
    OUT "WARN: last.json missing (we will still post with parsed title/url)"
  }

  # Eğer last.json içinde title yoksa, parse ettiğimizi kullan
  if (-not $title) {
    try { if ($p -and $p.title) { $title = [string]$p.title } } catch {}
  }

  # YouTube URL last.json içinde varsa al (bazı akışlarda işe yarar)
  if (-not $ytUrl) {
    try { if ($p -and $p.youtube) { $ytUrl = [string]$p.youtube } } catch {}
    try { if ($p -and $p.youtubeUrl) { $ytUrl = [string]$p.youtubeUrl } } catch {}
  }

  # =====================================================
  # 3) TELEGRAM + X (tam otomasyon)
  #    - X duplicate-safe: suffix ekliyoruz
  # =====================================================
  # Telegram metni
  $tgText = $null
  try { if ($p -and $p.telegram) { $tgText = [string]$p.telegram } } catch {}

  if (-not $tgText -or $tgText.Trim() -eq '') {
    if ($title -and $ytUrl) {
      $tgText = "New YouTube Short: $title`n$ytUrl`n#QuantumCoin #Shorts"
    } elseif ($ytUrl) {
      $tgText = "New YouTube Short:`n$ytUrl`n#QuantumCoin #Shorts"
    } else {
      $tgText = "New QuantumCoin update (slot $Slot) — YouTube @QuantumCoinHQ"
    }
  }

  # X metni
  $baseX = $null
  try { if ($p -and $p.x) { $baseX = [string]$p.x } } catch {}

  if (-not $baseX -or $baseX.Trim() -eq '') {
    if ($title -and $ytUrl) {
      $baseX = "$title — $ytUrl #crypto #shorts"
    } elseif ($ytUrl) {
      $baseX = "$ytUrl #crypto #shorts"
    } else {
      $baseX = "QuantumCoin daily update — YouTube @QuantumCoinHQ #crypto #shorts"
    }
  }

  # X'e her seferinde benzersiz suffix
  $suffix = " • $env:QC_TODAY S$Slot"
  $maxLen = 280 - $suffix.Length
  if ($baseX.Length -gt $maxLen) { $baseX = $baseX.Substring(0,$maxLen) }
  $xText = $baseX + $suffix

  # Kaydet (debug için)
  try {
    $outObj = [ordered]@{
      date = $env:QC_TODAY
      slot = $Slot
      title = $title
      youtubeUrl = $ytUrl
      telegram = $tgText
      x = $xText
      generatedAt = (Get-Date).ToString("s")
    }
    $outObj | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Out-File -FilePath $lastJson -Encoding UTF8
    OUT "last.json written/updated"
  } catch {
    OUT "WARN: last.json write failed"
  }

  # Telegram post
  if ($plats -contains 'telegram') {
    OUT "telegram announce start"
    $tgOut = & pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\publish-all.ps1 -Text $tgText -Platforms telegram 2>&1
    ($tgOut | Out-String).TrimEnd() | Out-File -FilePath $log -Append -Encoding UTF8
    OUT "telegram exit=$LASTEXITCODE"
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
  }

  # X post (duplicate retry)
  if ($plats -contains 'x') {
    OUT "x announce start"
    try {
      $xOut = & pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\publish-all.ps1 -Text $xText -Platforms x 2>&1
      ($xOut | Out-String).TrimEnd() | Out-File -FilePath $log -Append -Encoding UTF8
      OUT "x exit=$LASTEXITCODE"
    } catch {
      $err = ($_ | Out-String)
      OUT ("x ERR: " + $err.Trim())

      if ($err -match 'duplicate') {
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
        $suffix2 = " • $env:QC_TODAY S$Slot " + (Get-Date -Format "HHmmss")
        $maxLen2 = 280 - $suffix2.Length
        $b2 = $baseX
        if ($b2.Length -gt $maxLen2) { $b2 = $b2.Substring(0,$maxLen2) }
        $xRetry = $b2 + $suffix2

        OUT "x retry start"
        $x2Out = & pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\publish-all.ps1 -Text $xRetry -Platforms x 2>&1
        ($x2Out | Out-String).TrimEnd() | Out-File -FilePath $log -Append -Encoding UTF8
        OUT "x retry exit=$LASTEXITCODE"
      } else {
        exit 2
      }
    }
  }

  OUT "DONE OK"
  exit 0
}
catch {
  OUT ("FATAL: " + $_.Exception.Message)
  OUT ("STACK: " + ($_.ScriptStackTrace -replace "`r?`n"," | "))
  exit 2
}
finally {
  try {
    if ($lockStream) { $lockStream.Close(); $lockStream.Dispose() }
  } catch {}
}
